title: M-PSK Demodulator Baseband
text: Demodulate PSK-modulated data, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Constellation ordering} sets Symbol mapping; {M-ary number} sets the modulation order of the PSK constellation, {Output type} sets the output signal data, {Decision type} sets the demodulator output Hard, {Noise variance source} sets the source of noise variance, {Noise variance} sets the estimate of noise variance, {Constellation mapping} sets the user-defined symbol mapping, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the phase offset and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: M-ary number
params.values: Modulation order of the PSK constellation 8 (default) | scalar

params.name: Output type
params.values: Output signal data type Integer (default) | Bit

params.name: Decision type
params.values: Demodulator output Hard decision (default) | Log-likelihood ratio | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance source
params.values: Source of noise variance estimate Dialog (default) | Port

params.name: Noise variance
params.values: Estimate of noise variance 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Phase offset in radians pi/8 (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32
